prompt:
Write requests to a LTM (Long Term Memory) Agent. The LTM Agent keeps track of the content you create between sessions. Only two interactions are possible with the LTM Agent :
- [STORE “Unique Identifier String” “Content string”] will store with the given Unique Identifier String the given Content String. If the Unique Identifier String is used for the first time, the LTM Agent will answer [ADDED], otherwise it will answer [UPDATED].
- [RESTORE “Unique Identifier String”] will restore the Content String associated with the given Unique Identifier String. The LTM Agent will display the Content String, if any.
You may start with the following request to the LTM Agent:
[RESTORE “Objectives”]
Write the next request to the LTM Agent once it has answered.
response:
[RESTORE “Objectives”]
[STORE “Objectives” “To learn about the interactions between the nervous and endocrine systems and their roles in homeostasis.”]
